grammar.summary: 本课综合练习过去进行时叙事与 put up 场景动词短语。

points.title: put up 搭建与过去时叙事
points.explanation: 叙述野营场景：put up the tent（搭帐篷）短语动词的完整运用；时间推进 After a while / Later。

examples.en: They put up their tent in the middle of a field.
examples.cn: 他们在田野中央搭起了帐篷。

points.title: 过去进行时 vs 一般过去时叙事节奏
points.explanation: 背景 was sleeping / 突发 woke up。故事结尾 The stream wound its way... 描述性过去时。

examples.en: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal.
examples.cn: 一搭好帐篷，他们就做饭。
